en: Black‑and‑white street view of several substantial early‑20th‑century residential or institutional buildings with steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, bay windows and modest ornamentation, lining a broad, mostly empty road. A small clock tower is visible on one of the buildings, and in the distance there is a church‑like tower with an onion‑shaped dome. People in long coats walk along the sidewalk, and a few horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians use the road. Trees line the right side, giving the scene a suburban or garden‑suburb feel.
